name: Hoshiarpur

routes.outcome: Official district Government of Punjab page identifies Punjab Land Records Society Hoshiarpur at the District Administrative Complex and links land-record services. Local district custodian evidence; no parcel geometry endpoint exposed on this page.
Official Punjab BhuNaksha viewer loaded. Public HTML references assets/misc/config.js, index.js, village_selector.jsp, REST hierarchy routes, MapInfo extent route, and WMS map route.
Current viewer configuration inspected; SERVICE_PATH and COMMON_SERVER_PATH are same-origin relative paths.
Current JavaScript inspected. It uses rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel and rest/MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref, and renders VILLAGE_MAP/FMB_LAYERS through same-origin WMS.
State code 03 returned five hierarchy levels.

State 03 enumerated Punjab districts; district code 09 is ਹੁਸ਼ਿਆਰਪੁਰ. Subsequent bounded hierarchy requests identified tehsil 107 ਹੁਸ਼ਿਆਰਪੁਰ, kanungo 010 ਹੁਸ਼ਿਆਰਪੁਰ, patwar 125 ਨਲੋਈਆਂ, and village options including 31577 ਬਸੀ ਖਿਜਰ, 31574 ਅਖਲਾਸਪੁਰ, and 31575 ਬ੍ਰਹਮਜੀਤ.

Bounded anonymous village-map extent for state=03 and gisLevels=09,107,010,125,31577 returned gisCode 0910701012531577, projected numeric xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax, and attribution identifying the Hoshiarpur hierarchy. This is extent metadata only, not parcel geometry or a citywide hit.
Capabilities request failed at the public WMS route. TLS remained verified; no retry with disabled verification or credentials was made.
Guessed map-info route was not present; no further guessed route requests were made.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Same-origin relative service paths in config.js; public JavaScript passes srs=0 to the extent route.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: One selected Hoshiarpur hierarchy village extent; no parcel feature query was exposed by the inspected public viewer routes.

sourceFieldMapping.compositeKeyProvenance: Viewer-generated gisCode 0910701012531577 from selected hierarchy codes; treated as map scope provenance, not a parcel identity.

localCustodianAssessment: The Hoshiarpur district Government of Punjab page is direct local-district land-record custodian evidence. Punjab Land Records Society is state-level. BhuNaksha is the official state cadastral-map viewer; its public map route was independently inspected. National/general mapping search results were not treated as local registry evidence.

qualification.reason: Official local/state cadastral viewer and Hoshiarpur hierarchy are evidenced, but no anonymous parcel schema, CRS, safe parcel identity, or parcel geometry response was independently qualified.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [31.5263564171585,75.9092613371255] was preserved and not shifted.
No exact-point hit or miss was claimed; the successful extent request was for one selected village scope and does not establish the city point or citywide coverage.
A 500 WMS capabilities response and a 404 guessed route are transport/route outcomes, not evidence of absence.
No full parcel polygon is retained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal, certificate, citizenship, mobile, or OTP fields were requested or retained.
Viewer attribution states displayed spatial data are provisional and for viewing purposes only.
uncertainty: The official Hoshiarpur district land-record custodian and Punjab BhuNaksha viewer are verified. The viewer exposes hierarchy and village-map extent metadata, but anonymous parcel feature identity, geometry schema, CRS, citywide coverage, update cadence, and licensing remain unverified. Runtime adapter qualification remains held for serial review.
